title: Get the full picture of TMS at Grovewood Mental Health
description: We break down what transcranial magnetic stimulation involves, from the initial consultation, benefits investigation, securing prior authorization, through the full treatment course.

primary.textDescription: Call to schedule a TMS consultation

slides.title: Precision targeting
slides.description: Our coil placement targets the left prefrontal cortex using evidence-based protocols, not guesswork.

slides.title: Session structure
slides.description: Each session lasts about 20 minutes. You sit in a chair, awake and alert, with no sedation needed.

slides.title: Full treatment course
slides.description: A standard course runs five days a week for four to six weeks, with tapering sessions as response stabilizes.

slides.title: No recovery time
slides.description: You drive yourself to and from appointments. There is no downtime, no needles, and no systemic side effects.

slides.title: Ongoing monitoring
slides.description: We track your PHQ-9 scores weekly and adjust parameters based on your response data.

slides.title: Treating Depression Where It Starts
slides.description: There are specific areas in your brain that control mood. When synapses in those mood-regulating areas are underactive, connections are broken and depression can result. NeuroStar revitalizes those dormant synapses, "waking up" the brain to function as it was meant to.
